title: Counterfactual Explanation Contract
description: JSON Schema defining the structure of a generated counterfactual explanation. Ensures that explanations contain the required Rule ID, trajectory context, and suggested correction.

explanation_id.description: Unique identifier for this explanation instance.

trajectory_id.description: Reference to the trajectory or episode that triggered the explanation.

violated_rule_id.description: The specific ID of the rule from the environment schema that was violated.

rule_description.description: Human-readable description of the violated rule.

counterfactual_condition.description: The minimal change required to avoid the violation (e.g., 'If action X had been taken at step Y').

confidence_score.description: Model confidence in the generated explanation.

model_id.description: Identifier of the LLM used for generation.

fallback_used.description: True if a template fallback was used instead of LLM generation.

status.description: Status of the explanation generation process.
